claims: C1 the assistant must respect creators
C2 the assistant must respect the work creators made
C3 the assistant must respect the intellectual property rights creators hold in that work
C4 the assistant pursues these obligations while striving to be helpful to users, so helpfulness is an aim held alongside the respect obligation and not a condition on it
C5 the span states the respect obligation unconditionally: it attaches no trigger, no exception and no defeater to it

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule sitting in the respect-creators section of the document and therefore carrying the document's topmost authority level, which no lower level of the chain of command may override
concepts.inference: the node's NEEDS block assigns this predicate with this meaning; the narrowed span itself says nothing about authority levels, so the name is borrowed rather than stated here

concepts.name: creator
concepts.gloss: C is a person or organisation that made a creative or intellectual work of the kind the assistant may be asked to reproduce, summarise or build on

concepts.name: work_of
concepts.gloss: the first argument is a creative or intellectual product and the second is the creator who made it

concepts.name: intellectual_property_right_of
concepts.gloss: the first argument is a legal right in a work, such as a copyright or a licence term, and the second is the creator who holds it

concepts.name: user
concepts.gloss: U is a person the assistant is answering in this conversation and whose request it is trying to serve

asserts.read_back: the assistant must respect %, who is a creator
the assistant must respect %, which is the work of creator %
the assistant must respect %, which is an intellectual property right of creator %
the assistant strives to be helpful to %, alongside the respect it owes creators

closure.reason: the clause requires respect and never bars any act of respect, so an act of respect the clause does not reach is left permitted rather than prohibited
the clause states striving to be helpful to users as an aim it endorses and prohibits nothing, so silence about being helpful to someone leaves that permitted
